description: This file defines a base class for unit tests related to WebAudioPlayer IPC in the Rialto project. It includes mock objects, setup and teardown methods, and configuration details for testing the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcTestBase
classes.description: A base class for unit testing WebAudioPlayer IPC functionality, providing mock setup, configuration, and utility methods.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment after each test.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates an instance of the WebAudioPlayerIpc for testing.

methods.name: expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for subscribing to events.

methods.name: expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for unsubscribing from events.

methods.name: setCreateWebAudioPlayerResponse
methods.description: Sets the response message for creating a WebAudioPlayer.
